category_title: Older adolescents with severe CHARGE syndrome and challenging behaviors
minimal_context: David is sitting at a table in the school for mealtime and is presented with his lunch.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for lunch. Here is your food.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Refuses to eat, turning his head away from the food.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Come on, you need to eat your lunch.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues refusing to eat, pushing the food away.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to take at least one bite.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Exhibits disruptive behavior by throwing his food.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: throwing food and refusing to eat

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: exhibit challenging behavior such as throwing food and refusing to eat
